description: This file defines a utility enum GatewayEndpointID that provides functions for generating stable IDs and pretty descriptions for network endpoints, as well as normalizing service names for IDs.

methods.name: stableID
methods.description: Generates a stable string ID for a given NWEndpoint, handling service endpoints distinctly.

methods.name: prettyDescription
methods.description: Provides a readable description of an NWEndpoint, decoding any special escapes.

methods.name: normalizeServiceNameForID
methods.description: Normalizes a service name by decoding escapes, splitting on whitespace, and trimming.
